title: Charlie Kirk Assassination - Indiana Attorney General (Third Request)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Indiana Access to Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

1. Any submission to the "Education Transparency Form" on or after September 1, 2025. The form is located at https://in.accessgov.com/attorneygeneral/Forms/Page/eyesoneducation/education-transparency-form.

2. Any public records request submitted by or on behalf of the Office of the Attorney General to a public university or college since January 1, 2025.

Please note that this request seeks public records wherever they may be found, including on devices or networks owned or operated by private parties. For example, if an employee uses a personal cell phone or social media account to conduct public business, records created, maintained, or held on the phone or account are public records subject to this request.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 7 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Adam Steinbaugh

title: Arrest log fields and 30-day arrest log (Everett Police Department)

communications.communication:
Hello, and thank you for the work you do at the Everett Police Department.

I'm writing from the Records Desk at Tempo by Multido with a small public records request under the Washington Public Records Act (RCW 42.56). I know records staff are busy, so I've tried to keep this as simple as I can.

Could you please share:

1. A list of the fields your arrest records system keeps (for example: arrest number, arrest date, name, date of birth, charges, location, booking photo). A screenshot, a report header or a short description is perfectly fine.
2. The arrest log for the most recent 30 days, in whatever electronic form is easiest for you. A standard report export, a spreadsheet or a PDF all work.

I'd also love to know: does your office offer an email list, notification system or regular report (daily or weekly) that shares new bookings or arrests? If so, we'd be glad to sign up, so you wouldn't need to handle requests like this one in the future.

If any part is exempt, please feel free to send the rest. And if another office is the better place to ask, a quick pointer would be very much appreciated.

Thank you so much for your time and help. We really appreciate it.

Warmly,
Logan
